lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are organized into approximately four distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill region, forming a regular grid-like lattice across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating high-contrast anchor nodes where the vertical stripes and circular spots overlap.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least two prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher pixel values on the superior edge and deep shadows on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 8 to 12 high-luminance spots, distributed more densely at the base and becoming sparser toward the posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density arrangement of smaller, discrete high-luminance spots concentrated along the leading edge and distal tip, distinct from the larger flank blobs.
